That particular message presents when imap has not been enabled on outlooks webmail settings page. See the screen shot attached. You need to enable it.

If this is a new outlook account, you may run into a second error message once you get past the first one. Older accounts such as microsoft hotmail are unaffected.

Error: Smtpclientauthentication is disabled for the maillbox.

There's no resolution for the second issue at the moment.

Developer Feedback: https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/10787#issuecomment-4892119413

"Microsoft has been making significant changes recently without providing any disclosure or documentation that could help us understand these changes or how to address them."
